popCulture.description: Catalogue of Ships and Book 4: Chalcodon's son leads the Abantes from Euboea; he falls beside a corpse he meant to strip — captain of the long-haired spearmen.

popCulture.title: Elephenor
popCulture.description: King of the Abantes who led forty ships to Troy and died early in the fighting.
